title: Ox of Hephaestus — operational design reconciliation candidate v0.5

source_baseline.title: Ox of Hephaestus - ship setting and operations baseline

authority.ship_of_theseus_rule: original design, current installation and available documentation are distinct but linked layers
authority.fixed_spine_v0_2: Every major fixed workplace now has an authored compartment extent and physical access; the central logistics trunk is a separate system from the two personnel trunks.
authority.workshop_rotor_v0_3: Heavy machining and fabrication are carried on a dedicated variable-radius work rotor; fixed Engineering retains control, electronics, NDT, staging and rotor support functions.
authority.survivability_v0_4: Damage control, external maintenance access, distributed local machinery controls and layered backup life support are explicit physical systems. Backup systems preserve time and options; they do not make damage consequence-free.

mass.mission_allowance_note: Includes approximately 895.466 t previously identified inventory, up to 300 t trim water, and remaining bearing oil/thermal media/lubricants/manifest margin. An allocation is not a complete inventory.

atmosphere_design_screen.planning_status: 101 reference envelope pressure cells; 32 pressure zones remain unsized; installed free gas remains unknown; three independently isolatable subcells carved from already-counted hab arc shells

normal_oxygen_generation.method: treated-water electrolysis with oxygen purity conditioning
normal_oxygen_generation.note: Gross 730-day electrolysis feed is conservative; full closed-loop reclamation/byproduct chemistry could reduce net withdrawal but cannot be credited before implemented. Each full ECLSS train can service 40 persons when power, water, heat and gas rejection are intact.

normal_CO2_removal.method: regenerable sorbent and verified desorption/removal route
normal_CO2_removal.note: Captured carbon dioxide is removed from hab air but must also be disposed of or stored; a regenerable bed does not destroy carbon mass.

life_support_contract.makeup_water_planning_note: Working 162 t allocation: 73 t domestic unrecovered + 29.237 t gross O2 electrolysis feed + 35 t crop/food-process + 24.763 t technical losses/rejects. Conservative budget allocations, not measured operating consumption.

long_leg_food.notes: Stock includes dry shelf-stable food, packaging and allowance; water, disposal and refrigeration counted elsewhere.

refuge_occupancy_contract.limitations: Only an intact isolatable host arc can function as a 40-person refuge. The 40m2 refuge-store rooms house support hardware, not forty sleeping occupants.

repressurization_reserve.permitted_use: deliberate refill of one contained pressure cell or smaller losses; only where valves and gas purity are proven
repressurization_reserve.normal_valve_policy: storage/taps/rotary crossings normally closed; pressure-rated section valves can remain available
insufficient_conditions: incompatible pressure zone or unverified atmosphere
repressurization_reserve.free_gas_range_scope: 85 sized gas cells only; 48 other pressurised cells unsized, 83 non-breathable-by-default unclassified spaces

FTL.mass_convention: includes actual loaded fuel; frozen per leg for coarse dispatch
FTL.arrival_frame_match: provided by the fictional FTL navigation/field system within local manoeuvring budget

utility_philosophy.normal_maintenance: isolate smallest practical boundary; keep unaffected service operating
utility_philosophy.redundancy: alternate routes and standby equipment are finite and can share vulnerabilities
utility_philosophy.documentation: original shipyard records describe design intent, not necessarily current installed condition

modifications.title: Residential electrical renewal in HAB-03
modifications.reason: Recurring nuisance trips and unavailable original breaker cartridges.
modifications.current_effect: Second five-cabin group uses newer panel family; adapter stock and revised schedules required.

modifications.title: Cabin 07 ventilation supply moved off cabin panel
modifications.reason: New fan-coil controller exceeded the old cabin panel interface specification.
modifications.current_effect: Cabin ordinary panel isolation no longer removes fan-coil control power; corridor service-group isolation does.

modifications.title: Three-room cultivation conversion
modifications.current_effect: Added growing rooms, humidity plant, chilled-water demand and moved 212 m2 of workshop programme to fixed spine.

modifications.title: HAB-05 potable manifold replacement
modifications.reason: Original casting developed recurrent seat leakage.
modifications.current_effect: New manifold has different actuator family and more compact service layout.

modifications.title: HAB-05 laundry replacement package
modifications.reason: Original washer/extractor set became uneconomic to support.
modifications.current_effect: Laundry has newer power electronics; spare inverter is specific to this generation.

modifications.title: ECLSS-B control renewal over retained process hardware
modifications.reason: Obsolete control hardware; process vessels remained sound.
modifications.current_effect: Modern controller talks to older actuators through interface gateways; diagnostics are uneven across the train.

modifications.title: BR-06 service sleeve rebuild
modifications.reason: Historic service-sleeve damage; pressure bridge shell itself was retained.
modifications.current_effect: Utility isolators at this bridge are manual-local first; remote indication exists but remote actuation was not restored for every service.

modifications.title: Partial flywheel module renewal
modifications.reason: Staged life-extension replacement rather than a full-bank refit.
modifications.current_effect: Banks contain two module generations with common bus compatibility but different diagnostic connectors and bearing-service kits.

modifications.title: Auxiliary generator B replacement
modifications.reason: Original unit suffered irreparable core damage at a prior port.
modifications.current_effect: Newer generator is more reliable but uses a gateway to the original plant-control network.

modifications.title: BE-08 lubrication pump package replacement
modifications.reason: Original pump unavailable after a bearing-service campaign.
modifications.current_effect: Replacement has better flow margin but reduces extraction clearance for the adjacent filter; routine filter change takes longer.

modifications.title: Mixed-generation bow shield panels
modifications.reason: Impact damage and routine panel replacement over service life.
modifications.current_effect: Several sectors use newer panel stacks and attachment hardware; protection remains within current ship standard but inspection fasteners and panel markings differ by era.

modifications.title: Personnel-cart and block-control renewal
modifications.reason: Original slow service carts had become maintenance-heavy.
modifications.current_effect: Modern battery carts use the original trunk guide geometry; station hardware is mixed old/new and the emergency manual-tow fittings remain original.

modifications.title: Heavy logistics trunk drive renewal
modifications.reason: Original freight tugs were replaced while retaining the pressure shutters and much of the guideway.
modifications.current_effect: Current sleds are faster and self-diagnosing; several shutter drives and guide sections remain original.

modifications.title: Variable-gravity Engineering workshop conversion
modifications.reason: Repeated zero-g machining and contamination-control difficulties made the original fixed heavy shop increasingly undesirable; refit moved heavy shop functions onto an independently rotating variable-radius assembly while retaining clean electronics/NDT work in the fixed spine.
modifications.current_effect: Machine shop and fabrication can operate from ~0.32 g to ~1 g by changing radius at normal 3.45 rpm. Opposed stores carriage is about three times heavier and moves only one-third as far, keeping common spares relatively close to the hub.
notes: The former machine-shop bay now houses rotor support machinery; former heavy-fabrication bay is the hard-lock freight staging bay.

modifications.title: Workshop-rotor stores carriage accretion
modifications.reason: Years of replacement stock and machine-tool changes altered the stores-carriage mass distribution.
modifications.current_effect: Nominal 3:1 moving-mass ratio is maintained by stowage discipline plus trim water/weights; exact rack location matters to fine balance.

modifications.title: Sectionalised damage-control/fire-main refit
modifications.reason: Original fire response was progressively upgraded after service experience and later habitation refits.
modifications.current_effect: Dual fixed mains, two habitat rotary feeds, distributed DC lockers and mixed-generation suppression equipment.

modifications.title: Exterior rail/crawler maintenance route consolidation
modifications.reason: Reduced routine free-flight EVA and improved access to shield, radiator, bearing and aft plant work.
modifications.current_effect: Continuous fixed-spine exterior work route with restricted transfers to rotating drums and radiators.

modifications.title: Distributed short-duration life-support backup refit
modifications.reason: Preserve useful recovery time during isolated-arc and distribution casualties without adding a third full ECLSS train.
modifications.current_effect: Each arc has short-duration local scrubber/O2; refuge and survival-craft packages remain deeper backup layers.

current_configuration_notes.text: Ventilation/fan-coil control supply differs from original cabin drawing; current electrical schedule is correct.
Replacement pump package narrows adjacent filter extraction path; allow extra service time.
Wet-service isolation is local-manual at rebuilt sleeve; remote indications remain available.
Cable-tray reserve capacity uncertain until abandoned routes are field-verified.
Mixed-generation control gateway means some actuator diagnostics are less granular than ECLSS-A.
Heavy logistics trunk is not a commercial bulk conveyor. Use internal freight locks for bounded modules/machinery; major bulk redistribution normally waits for port/external handling.
Forward shield panel generations differ by sector; use current panel map rather than original fastener schedule during EVA replacement.
General machining deployment is shop radius 60 m (~0.80 g) / stores radius 20 m (~0.27 g). Move both carriages together under balance control; fine trim follows current stores manifest.
Heavy stock stowage positions affect WR-01 fine balance. Rack assignment is operational data, not merely inventory bookkeeping.
Forward and aft fire pumps are both serviceable; central cross-tie remains normally shut to preserve segregation.
Aft exterior crawler traction wheel set is newer than the forward unit; both use the same current battery modules but different legacy brake actuators.
HAB-03 emergency scrubber is a later replacement model; cartridge chemistry is compatible but its fan controller is not interchangeable with the other seven.

dorsal_work_bays.purpose: occupied control, clean work, stores and service rooms

ventral_work_bays.purpose: industrial work, power, machinery and dirty service rooms

cross_section.utility_raceways: distributed in remaining annular wedges; not separate character rooms unless local access matters

fixed_spine_contract.pressure_philosophy: personnel trunks, logistics trunk and occupied rooms are sectionalized; unoccupied machinery bays may remain vacuum spaces
fixed_spine_contract.gravity: zero-g; Engineering Control, electronics, NDT, logistics and support machinery remain fixed. Heavy machining/fabrication moved to independently rotating variable-radius work rotor WR-01.

pressure_segmentation.personnel_trunk_A: 23 sections, one pressure cell per section; separately identified doors admit controlled equalization when open
pressure_segmentation.personnel_trunk_B: 23 sections, one pressure cell per section; separately identified doors admit controlled equalization when open
pressure_segmentation.cross_connections: separately protected pressure cells with independent A/B trunk access doors
pressure_segmentation.operational_rule: A door that is open equalizes neighbouring gas cells; automatic closure isolates actual pressure volume. Section IDs remain stable across pressure emergencies.
pressure_segmentation.flywheel_bays: F1-BAY and F2-BAY are normally unpressurised machine containment spaces entered through independent service airlocks.

personnel_service_trunks.cart_capacity: 6 restrained people plus hand baggage, or approximately 500 kg service load
personnel_service_trunks.traffic: bidirectional under local block control; carts pull into wall alcoves/stations so a disabled cart does not permanently close the trunk

heavy_logistics_trunk.use: stores, machinery, spares and moderate sealed cargo modules; not the normal path for commercial bulk loading
heavy_logistics_trunk.oversize_rule: objects outside the clear envelope or practical sled inertia limit require external/port handling
heavy_logistics_trunk.workshop_rotor_interface: central staging at x≈500 m; 50-100 t sled loads transfer only with WR-01 stopped, retracted, indexed and hard-locked
heavy_logistics_trunk.bounding_box_rule: All load, fixtures, restraint and movable parts must fit within the 3.8 x 3.4 x 8 m envelope; load rating and route permissions are separate.

inter_drum_transfer.source_and_destination_drums_must_be: stopped, aligned and hard-locked for freight-lock use
inter_drum_transfer.compatible_loads: palletized/containerized cargo, machinery, tanks or sealed bulk modules within lock/sled envelope
inter_drum_transfer.not_for: routine transfer of tens of thousands of tonnes of loose bulk between drums
inter_drum_transfer.bounded_module_rule: Stopped, hard-locked drum freight locks must themselves clear the full load box; ordinary service locks never handle heavy cargo.

freight_lock_reference.guarantee: design envelope with 2m axial clearance at each closed end; seal/dog/stopping swept hardware still requires as-installed verification

debris_protection_contract.principle: layered protection; no single magnetic shield is treated as magic

ordinary_spaceflight.large_objects: navigation sensors detect/track avoidable macroscopic hazards; manoeuvre or abort if necessary
ordinary_spaceflight.small_neutral_particles: replaceable multi-layer spaced bow bumper and local stuffed-Whipple-like shielding on occupied/critical areas
ordinary_spaceflight.charged_particles_and_ionized_microdust: forward ionization/electrostatic/magnetic curtain reduces charged-particle and fine-dust flux but is not credited as the sole barrier
ordinary_spaceflight.water_mass: existing mission water is deliberately distributed in segmented forward tank cells around command/electronics as secondary fragment/radiation mass; exposed ice is not the primary bumper
ordinary_spaceflight.local_vulnerability: radiators, sensors, antennas and deployed machinery use local shields, shutters, redundancy and inspection because they cannot all hide behind the bow shield

FTL_translation.setting_rule: the same translation-field physics that permits FTL prevents ordinary microscopic matter from crossing into the translated envelope as a normal hypervelocity impact
FTL_translation.macroscopic_intersection: not permitted; navigation must establish a safe transition corridor and the field trips/aborts on unacceptable exclusion-volume returns
FTL_translation.reason: without this setting rule, ordinary interstellar dust at superluminal travel would make the stated FTL regime meaningless

debris_protection_contract.damage_model: shield panels pit/erode and are surveyed/replaced; a penetrator can still damage local structure, utilities or sensors without automatically destroying the ship

workshop_rotor_contract.purpose: variable-gravity heavy engineering work and immediately accessible engineering stock
workshop_rotor_contract.rotation_direction: independently commanded; normally coordinated against ship rotor momentum schedule
workshop_rotor_contract.balance_rule: m_shop * r_shop approximately equals m_stores * r_stores; nominal mass ratio is 1:3 so r_stores = r_shop/3
workshop_rotor_contract.fine_balance: segmented trim-water masses and small movable trim weights correct inventory changes and ordinary loading asymmetry
workshop_rotor_contract.access: two opposed telescoping pressurized passages meet at a central rotating hub; walking distance between carriage centres varies with deployment and is approximately r_shop+r_stores
workshop_rotor_contract.heavy_transfer: for 50-100 t logistics-sled transfers the work rotor stops, retracts to transfer configuration, indexes and hard-locks to the fixed heavy-logistics dock
workshop_rotor_contract.personnel_transfer: small independent indexed transfer between fixed spine and rotating work hub; ordinary crew access does not require stopping the work rotor
workshop_rotor_contract.reason: routine machining, fluids, swarf control and bench work benefit strongly from gravity while heavy logistics and electronics work remain useful in zero-g
workshop_rotor_contract.mass_accounting: reallocation of existing workshop/stores/central-service dry allowances; no change to 275,000 t ship dry planning total

damage_control_contract.principle: contain first, preserve routes and breathable volume, then attack/repair; redundancy buys time but does not erase smoke, heat, contamination or access loss

fire_main.fixed_spine: dual A/B mains with forward and aft pumps and central cross-tie
fire_main.habitation: sectionalised ring with two independent rotary inlets
fire_main.water_source: protected technical/firefighting allocation within existing mission-fluid allowance; potable makeup possible only by deliberate cross-connection

damage_control_contract.smoke_control: pressure-sector isolation plus recirculating smoke cleanup; vent-to-vacuum is a deliberate last-resort action, not automatic fire response
damage_control_contract.portable_equipment: distributed DC lockers contain breathing sets, patch/plug kits, thermal camera, portable fan, portable pump, extinguishers, temporary hose/cable and basic casualty rigging
damage_control_contract.sector_rule: every traversable space belongs to a damage-control sector; local isolation and route status are simulation state

external_maintenance_contract.principle: routine exterior inspection has designed routes, anchors and work platforms; EVA is not free-flight by default
external_maintenance_contract.primary_route: fixed-spine exterior rail/handhold route from forward to aft EVA stations
external_maintenance_contract.drum_skin_rule: human access to rotating drum skin requires drum stopped, aligned and hard-locked; remote inspection crawlers can inspect selected exterior surfaces without human EVA
external_maintenance_contract.radiator_rule: close approach requires affected radiator section isolated and placed in maintenance attitude; heat rejection must be reassessed before isolation
external_maintenance_contract.propulsion_rule: aft propulsion exterior access requires propulsion inhibited, residual-energy/thermal checks and plume keep-out confirmation
external_maintenance_contract.tether_rule: two-point tether or rail-capture within exterior work routes; free translation requires specific task plan

local_control_contract.principle: major machinery remains locally observable and controllable if shipwide remote control or a central console is unavailable
local_control_contract.authority: local control does not bypass mechanical interlocks, lockout/tagout or command authority; local takeover is logged
local_control_contract.minimum_capability: local start/stop where safe, mode selection, essential indications, manual isolation status and emergency trip/reset appropriate to the plant
local_control_contract.power: protected/local battery ride-through for controls where loss of indication during a casualty would materially impede recovery
local_control_contract.network_loss: stations retain safe local functions without assuming the shipwide data network is healthy

backup_life_support_contract.principle: layered local survival rather than a hidden third full-ship ECLSS train
backup_life_support_contract.hab_short_isolation: each arc has a cartridge scrubber and 4.45 kg protected oxygen bank, nominally enough for ten people for about 12 hours at the reference oxygen rate; it buys time to restore distribution or move people
backup_life_support_contract.refuge_mode: HAB-04 and HAB-08 each have independent 40-person 72-hour scrubber/oxygen/battery support; the two refuge oxygen banks are 106.8 kg each
backup_life_support_contract.ultimate_local_survival: two fixed-spine survival craft each retain independent 40-person/30-day life support as already accepted setting capability
backup_life_support_contract.portable_support: damage-control breathing sets and portable scrubber/fan modules support rescue and temporary sealed-space work; they are not a substitute for pressure integrity
backup_life_support_contract.oxygen_accounting: 106.8 kg in each refuge plus 4.45 kg in each of eight arc isolation banks = 249.2 kg protected shipboard respiratory oxygen; no duplicate protected stock is created
backup_life_support_contract.limitations: backup systems still require intact pressure volume, heat rejection within their stated duration, consumable cartridges/oxygen and reachable people

operating_rules.cradle_support: Three cradle saddles per each of eight 38-degree arcs (24): centre keyed diaphragm box, two independent sliding outer supports; each outer support uses three spatially distinct frame branches (48 total), non-clamping positive retainers, controlled spin-down after station failure.

operating_rules.cargo_freight: Each source and receiving drum is stopped, indexed and structurally hard-locked before freight lock use.
operating_rules.work_rotor: Live personnel transfer can occur through independent indexed capsule; 50-100 t freight requires fully stopped/retracted/indexed/hard-locked rotor.
operating_rules.protected_power: 0.65 MW single auxiliary mode serves explicitly shed essential loads, not the full 0.75 MW protected service schedule.
operating_rules.observation: Sensors and controls reveal observable state only; even an accurate schematic is not magically current character knowledge.
operating_rules.arc_end_hatches: Inward-opening pressure-seated leaf: 120mm inward withdrawal then 90deg swing in arc vestibule; dual seals and 16 positively retained dogs; pressure differential blocks opening.
